name: Caesars Palace
description: Caesars Palace is a luxury casino hotel in Paradise, Nevada, United States. The hotel is situated on the west side of the Las Vegas Strip between Bellagio and the under-construction Hard Rock Las Vegas. It is one of Las Vegas's largest and best known landmarks.
